title.value: Assembly Bill No. 2771 – AB 2771, Friedman. Cosmetic products: safety.
title.provenance:
Assembly Bill No. 2771

AB 2771, Friedman. Cosmetic products: safety.

location.provenance: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:

pfas_definition.provenance: 'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: no person or entity shall manufacture, sell, deliver, hold, or offer for sale in commerce any cosmetic product that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).

who.provenance: no person or entity shall manufacture, sell, deliver, hold, or offer for sale in commerce

action.provenance: manufacture, sell, deliver, hold, or offer for sale

products.provenance: any cosmetic product that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)

intentionally_added.provenance:
'Intentionally added PFAS' means either of the following:
(1) PFAS chemicals that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product ...

and the ban language refers to "intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)".
